test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'.

The Karaoke programme __was planned by the club__ was a grand success.

options.text: has been planned by the club

solution:
The correct answer is "**planned by the club**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
